newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money market rates close lower.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money market rates close lower.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates closed sharply lower on Wednesday owing to surplus funds in the banking system despite the State (central) Bank of Pakistan weekly open market operation, dealers said.

The overnight market closed at 1.00 percent after the central bank announced the result of its operation by reducing a cutoff to 16.95 percent, 25 basis points less than the previous cutoff, and accepting 1.5 billion rupees, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
The bank announced a special operation for Thursday and the rates would depend upon its result, the dealer said.
